title: Quiet Feet
summary: Nell Tolley was something else before she kept an inn, and won't say what. She will say that a rogue who can't get behind three Redhand sergeants isn't one.

steps.journal: Put down three Redhand sergeants in Wickham Keep. They lead every fifth wave or so.

ready: Go back to Nell Tolley in Thornwick.
done: Nell taught your rogues Smoke Step, on the Crossed Keys' stairs, without once making them creak.
